title: Daniyal Mansur, Founder and CEO of 22 Signals
description: Daniyal Mansur is the founder and CEO of 22 Signals, a global business solutions company, helping ambitious companies lead the next era of business.
intro: Daniyal Mansur has always been obsessed with how technology shapes the way the world works. He founded 22 Signals to help ambitious companies lead the next era of business, whether they are just starting out or have been around for decades. He holds an MSc in Business Analytics from Queen Mary University of London.

p: Most businesses already know what they should change. What holds them back is the gap between the plan and the people who have to deliver it.

That gap is why Daniyal built 22 Signals. It brings data and AI, digital, cloud and creative under one team, so a company can rethink how it operates, gets found and grows with one team instead of ten. So far that is 30+ companies served and 30+ custom AI tools and systems built.

sections.h: AI is a way of operating, not a feature
p: In his view, the next era of business won't be won by the companies that buy the most AI tools. It will be won by the ones that redesign how work actually gets done, then use AI to run it. That starts with the process, not the tool: find the work a team repeats every day, fix how it flows, then automate it and measure what changed.

Outside of 22 Signals, Daniyal trades financial markets. Reading data, managing risk and staying calm under volatility is the same discipline he brings to every company he works with: make the decision the data supports, size the risk, and hold to the plan when things get noisy.

At 17 he launched Salt Esports, which made him the youngest founder in the Punjab IT Board's National Expansion Plan. It threw him into the deep end of high-stakes execution early. He backs that hands-on experience with an MSc in Business Analytics from Queen Mary University of London.
